about: Bannari Amman Sugars is an integrated South Indian sugar and bio-energy producer operating five sugar mills in Tamil Nadu and Karnataka, with bagasse cogeneration, two molasses-based distilleries, seven windmills, agri-natural fertiliser/biocompost and a scaled-down granite operation. Capacity comprises 23,700 TCD sugarcane crushing, 217.5 KLPD distillery, 129.8 MW cogeneration and 8.75 MW wind power. [1] [2]
